version: v1
sharing:
  timeSlicing:
    resources:
      - name: nvidia.com/gpu
        replicas: 4

# Format
# If line starts with a '#' it is considered a comment
# DCGM FIELD, Prometheus metric type, help message

# Clocks
DCGM_FI_DEV_SM_CLOCK,  gauge, SM clock frequency (in MHz).
DCGM_FI_DEV_MEM_CLOCK, gauge, Memory clock frequency (in MHz).

# Temperature
DCGM_FI_DEV_MEMORY_TEMP, gauge, Memory temperature (in C).
DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP,    gauge, GPU temperature (in C).

# Power
DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_USAGE,              gauge, Power draw (in W).
DCGM_FI_DEV_TOTAL_ENERGY_CONSUMPTION, counter, Total energy consumption since boot (in mJ).

# PCIE
DCGM_FI_PROF_PCIE_TX_BYTES,  counter, Total number of bytes transmitted through PCIe TX via NVML.
DCGM_FI_PROF_PCIE_RX_BYTES,  counter, Total number of bytes received through PCIe RX via NVML.
DCGM_FI_DEV_PCIE_REPLAY_COUNTER, counter, Total number of PCIe retries.

# Utilization (the sample period varies depending on the product)
DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL,      gauge, GPU utilization (in %).
DCGM_FI_DEV_MEM_COPY_UTIL, gauge, Memory utilization (in %).
DCGM_FI_DEV_ENC_UTIL,      gauge, Encoder utilization (in %).
DCGM_FI_DEV_DEC_UTIL,      gauge, Decoder utilization (in %).

# Errors and violations
DCGM_FI_DEV_XID_ERRORS,            gauge,   Value of the last XID error encountered.

# Memory usage
DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_FREE, gauge, Framebuffer memory free (in MiB).
DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED, gauge, Framebuffer memory used (in MiB).
DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_RESERVED, gauge, Framebuffer memory reserved (in MiB).

# VGPU License status
DCGM_FI_DEV_VGPU_LICENSE_STATUS, gauge, vGPU License status

# Remapped rows
DCGM_FI_DEV_UNCORRECTABLE_REMAPPED_ROWS, counter, Number of remapped rows for uncorrectable errors
DCGM_FI_DEV_CORRECTABLE_REMAPPED_ROWS,   counter, Number of remapped rows for correctable errors
DCGM_FI_DEV_ROW_REMAP_FAILURE,           gauge,   Whether remapping of rows has failed

# Static configuration information. These appear as labels on the other metrics
DCGM_FI_DRIVER_VERSION,        label, Driver Version

# DCP metrics
DCGM_FI_PROF_GR_ENGINE_ACTIVE,   gauge, Ratio of time the graphics engine is active.
DCGM_FI_PROF_PIPE_TENSOR_ACTIVE, gauge, Ratio of cycles the tensor (HMMA) pipe is active.
DCGM_FI_PROF_DRAM_ACTIVE,        gauge, Ratio of cycles the device memory interface is active sending or receiving data.
DCGM_FI_PROF_PCIE_TX_BYTES,      gauge, The rate of data transmitted over the PCIe bus - including both protocol headers and data payloads - in bytes per second.
DCGM_FI_PROF_PCIE_RX_BYTES,      gauge, The rate of data received over the PCIe bus - including both protocol headers and data payloads - in bytes per second.

ui:
  hide-url: true
  hide-hostname: true
conditions:
  - "[STATUS] == 200"
interval: 5m

mkdir -p /data/serverfiles/insurgency/cfg && cp /insserver.cfg /data/serverfiles/insurgency/cfg/insserver.cfg && cp /motd.txt /data/serverfiles/insurgency/motd.txt && chown -R 1000:1000 /data && echo "Setup complete"

[rack-ups]
  driver = "usbhid-ups"
  port = "auto"
  vendorid = "10AF"
  productid = "0001"
  product = "LiebertPSI"
  serial = ""
  vendor = "Emerson Network Power"
  bus = "002"

[upsmon]
  password  = "${SECRET_NUT_PASSWORD}"
  actions = SET
  instcmds = ALL
  upsmon primary

MONITOR rack-ups@localhost:3493 1 upsmon "${SECRET_NUT_PASSWORD}" primary
POLLFREQ 15
POLLFREQALERT 5
HOSTSYNC 15

/hr/registry-1.docker.io-bitnamicharts-e.title: external-dns helm release
/hr/registry-1.docker.io-bitnamicharts-e.name: external-dns
/hr/registry-1.docker.io-bitnamicharts-e.doc: ExternalDNS is a Kubernetes add-on that automatically manages the creation and updates of DNS records for services running in your cluster. It integrates with a variety of DNS providers, such as CloudFlare DNS, Amazon Route 53, Google Cloud DNS, and more, to ensure that your applications are easily accessible from anywhere with a DNS name. With ExternalDNS, you can simplify the process of managing DNS records for your home lab, eliminating the need for manual updates and reducing the risk of errors.

0:
version: v2
# In-cluster ClusterIP publicAddr of the proxy. tbot only joins and renews
# SVIDs (no reverse tunnel), so it honors the dialed address and reaches the
# proxy directly — bypassing the internal gateway. The proxy lists this name
# in publicAddr and serves a matching internal keypair, so TLS/SNI validate.
proxy_server: teleport-cluster.security.svc.cluster.local:443
onboarding:
  token: tape-archiver-control-worker
  join_method: kubernetes
storage:
  type: memory
services:
  - type: workload-identity-jwt
    selector:
      name: tape-archiver-control-worker
    audiences:
      - temporal.${SECRET_PUBLIC_DOMAIN_NAME}
    destination:
      type: directory
      path: /var/run/teleport/jwt
